description: List a pool system’s schedules (programs/timers). iAqua (Jandy AquaLink RS) panels: the panel’s own schedule — circuit, start, stop (24-hour, plus the panel’s text) and run days, with the page/row each sits at (what iaqualink_edit_schedule and iaqualink_delete_schedule identify it by) — read through iAqualink WebTouch, the panel emulation. If WebTouch is unavailable it falls back to the iQ20 schedule list (adapter firmware 3+), trying each candidate host once and reporting which answered (`probe`). eXO salt chlorinators: the pump, chlorinator and aux timers (name, start/stop, enabled, rpm for variable-speed pumps). Returns `supported: false` with the reason when there are none to read.
name: iaqualink_list_schedules
